eval.description: xAI internal dual-use biology refusal eval spanning high-level categories such as virology, wet-lab methods, chemical synthesis, toxicology, and laboratory safety. It scores whether the model withholds assistance on the most hazardous enablement prompts, not scientific accuracy. Cards report dual-use refusal on the severity-5 subset (higher is safer). Lab-internal.
eval.summary: Tests whether the model refuses to help with the most dangerous dual-use biology and chemistry requests.

versions.changes: xAI BioUseBench as reported on Grok 4.5–4.7 cards; severity-5 dual-use refusal is the headline signal.

scores.description: Whether the model refuses a severity-5 dual-use biology enablement prompt.

metrics.description: Share of severity-5 dual-use items refused. Treated as a CBRN safeguard signal, not a knowledge score.
